measurement_basis.rationale: Two fresh-load replicates plus five public additions and one compact candidate should fit well inside six hours on eight H200 workers; the cap includes environment, download, audit, and retry headroom.

deadline_policy: The six-hour ceiling applies to aggregate worker wall time from first ranked evaluation dispatch through final ranked dispatch. Preflight, immutable-asset download, environment preparation, independent audit, and report generation are separately bounded but do not consume ranked GPU evaluation lease time.

execution.completion_action: pause every exact owned worker; retain filesystem 3111

objective: Rerun the corrected current open-weight Nepali ASR landscape and the current Kriti candidate on one deterministic frozen view, with complete attempt and artifact provenance.

scope.historical_internal_checkpoint: reported as unranked context unless freshly rerun under v2
